summary: Covenant Logistics Group filed an 8-K on August 17, 2026, announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share on Class A and Class B common stock, declared by the Board on August 13, 2026. The dividend is payable September 25, 2026 to shareholders of record September 4, 2026. This is a standard quarterly distribution under an existing approved program, not a special situation. The filing includes no unusual terms, strategic actions, or required approvals beyond standard board declaration. Investors should note this is a regular capital return event and not an actionable special-situation transaction.
